title: City Introduces Bike Lanes
text:
The city council has approved a plan to build 40 kilometres of new bike lanes over the next three years. According to the report, the project aims to reduce traffic congestion and lower air pollution in the city centre. Council members argued that many residents already cycle to work but feel unsafe on busy roads. Consequently, the council decided to separate the bike lanes from car traffic with physical barriers.

Not everyone supports the plan, however. Some local shop owners are worried that fewer parking spaces will reduce their customers. In response, the council promised to review the effects on businesses after the first year. Critics say the review should have been completed before construction began. Supporters, on the other hand, believe the benefits will outweigh the short-term inconvenience.

questions.text: What is the main aim of the bike lane project?
options: To reduce traffic congestion and air pollution
To increase the number of car parks
To build new roads for buses
To close the city centre to cyclists

questions.text: What are some local shop owners worried about?
options: Fewer parking spaces and fewer customers
Losing their jobs to the council

questions.text: Why did the council decide to use physical barriers?
options: Because the barriers are cheap to install
Because cyclists felt unsafe next to fast-moving cars
Because the barriers will be removed after one year
Because residents asked for more parking

questions.text: What can be inferred about the critics' view of the council's decision-making?
options: They think the council should have reviewed the effects earlier
They believe the bike lanes should be removed immediately
They think construction should have been faster
They want the council to build only more car parks

paragraph_translations: Şehir meclisi, önümüzdeki üç yıl içinde 40 kilometre yeni bisiklet yolu inşa etme planını onayladı. Rapora göre proje, şehir merkezindeki trafik sıkışıklığını azaltmayı ve hava kirliliğini düşürmeyi amaçlıyor. Meclis üyeleri, birçok sakinin zaten işe bisikletle gittiğini ama yoğun yollarda kendini güvende hissetmediğini savundu. Bu nedenle meclis, bisiklet yollarını fiziksel bariyerlerle araç trafiğinden ayırmaya karar verdi.

Ancak herkes bu planı desteklemiyor. Bazı yerel dükkan sahipleri, daha az park yeri olmasının müşterilerini azaltacağından endişe ediyor. Buna karşılık meclis, ilk yıldan sonra işletmeler üzerindeki etkileri gözden geçireceğini söyledi. Eleştirmenler, bu incelemenin inşaat başlamadan önce yapılması gerektiğini söylüyor. Destekleyenler ise kısa vadeli rahatsızlığın sağlayacağı faydaların daha ağır basacağına inanıyor.
